scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle, then returning to the original lane.
A designated area marked by signs, overhead yellow lights and pavement markings where pedestrians cross a road without traffic lights.
A continuous line painted on the pavement at the left of a lane.
A line of dashes painted on the pavement at the left of a lane.
A large commercial vehicle such as a tractor-trailer or bus.
An orange and red sign displayed on the rear of a vehicle travelling at 40 km/h or less.
Tractors, combines and other farm vehicles on the road.
A vehicle pulled by a horse, such as a cart or buggy.
A snow-removal vehicle equipped with flashing blue lights.
The lane next to the far left lane on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction, used by trucks to pass.

rules.title: Keep right unless turning left or passing
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving on a road
rules.action: keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on multi-lane roads
rules.unless: the DRIVER wants to turn left OR the DRIVER wants to pass another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving on a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane on multi-lane roads, UNLESS the DRIVER wants to turn left OR the DRIVER wants to pass another vehicle.

rules.title: No pass unless sure it is safe
rules.when: the DRIVER is about to overtake and pass another vehicle
rules.action: overtake and pass the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is sure the pass can be made without danger to the DRIVER or others
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is about to overtake and pass another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT overtake and pass the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is sure the pass can be made without danger to the DRIVER or others.

vague_terms.term: without danger to the DRIVER or others

rules.note: The same block adds 'If in doubt, do not pass'.

rules.title: Freeway: keep right, use left lanes for passing
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving along a freeway
rules.action: keep to the right and use the left lanes for passing
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving along a freeway, the DRIVER SHOULD keep to the right and use the left lanes for passing.

rules.title: Freeway: use far left lane to pass slower traffic
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing traffic moving slower than the speed limit on a multi-lane freeway
rules.action: use the far left lane to pass
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing traffic moving slower than the speed limit on a multi-lane freeway, the DRIVER MUST use the far left lane to pass.

rules.title: Freeway: do not stay in the far left lane
rules.when: the DRIVER is in the far left lane of a multi-lane freeway
rules.action: stay in the far left lane
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in the far left lane of a multi-lane freeway, the DRIVER MUST NOT stay in the far left lane.

rules.title: Freeway: drive in the right-hand lane when possible
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving on a freeway
rules.action: drive in the right-hand lane when possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST drive in the right-hand lane when possible.

vague_terms.explanation: no definition of when it is not possible

rules.title: Keep-right-lane sign
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving on a road marked with the keep-right-lane sign
rules.action: keep to the right lane
rules.unless: the DRIVER is passing on a two-lane section where a climbing or passing lane is provided
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving on a road marked with the keep-right-lane sign, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right lane, UNLESS the DRIVER is passing on a two-lane section where a climbing or passing lane is provided.

rules.title: Signal and check before entering the passing lane
rules.when: the DRIVER is about to pass a vehicle
rules.action: use the left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is about to pass a vehicle, the DRIVER MUST use the left-turn signal AND check that the way is clear ahead and behind before moving into the passing lane.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Watch for hidden and entering road users before passing
rules.when: the DRIVER is about to pass a vehicle
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden in front of the vehicle being passed, vehicles turning left in front, and vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is about to pass a vehicle, the DRIVER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden in front of the vehicle being passed, vehicles turning left in front, and vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Return to the original lane when the front of the passed vehicle is visible
rules.when: the DRIVER has overtaken a vehicle
rules.action: signal to move back into the original lane AND make the lane change when the entire front of the vehicle being passed is visible in the inside mirror
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has overtaken a vehicle, the DRIVER MUST signal to move back into the original lane AND make the lane change when the entire front of the vehicle being passed is visible in the inside mirror.

rules.title: Do not cut off a vehicle when returning to the lane
rules.when: the DRIVER is moving back into the lane after overtaking
rules.action: cut off a vehicle by suddenly moving in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is moving back into the lane after overtaking, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT cut off a vehicle by suddenly moving in front of it.

rules.title: Do not race the vehicle being passed
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up
rules.action: race the vehicle being passed
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up, the DRIVER MUST NOT race the vehicle being passed.

rules.title: Go back to the original lane if the passed vehicle speeds up
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up
rules.action: go back to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up, the DRIVER MUST go back to the original lane.

rules.title: No passing within 30 metres of a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Stated on two pages, both as a prohibition; the pedestrian-crossover sign pair also shows a NO PASSING HERE TO CROSSING sign.

rules.title: No passing left of the centreline near a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass left of the centreline.

rules.title: No passing at a hill crest or on a curve with obstructed vision
rules.when: the DRIVER is approaching the crest of a hill or on a curve AND the DRIVER's vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
rules.action: attempt to pass
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is approaching the crest of a hill or on a curve AND the DRIVER's vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass.

vague_terms.term: not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety

rules.title: No passing in fog
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving in fog
rules.action: pass other vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass other vehicles.
rules.note: 14.19 words this as 'avoid passing' (ADVICE); 14.35 says 'Don't pass other vehicles' (INSTRUCTION). Recorded at the stronger strength.

rules.title: No speeding up to pass in fog
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving in fog
rules.action: speed up to pass a vehicle moving slowly OR to get away from a vehicle following too closely
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up to pass a vehicle moving slowly OR to get away from a vehicle following too closely.

rules.title: No passing in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.action: attempt to pass a vehicle moving slowly OR speed up to get away from a vehicle following too closely
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving in blowing snow or a whiteout, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass a vehicle moving slowly OR speed up to get away from a vehicle following too closely.
rules.note: 14.68 words the no-pass part as 'avoid passing' (ADVICE); 14.76 says 'Don't attempt to pass' (INSTRUCTION).

rules.title: Do not pass between staggered snow plows on a freeway
rules.when: several SNOW PLOWS are staggered across a freeway
rules.action: pass between them
rules.statement: WHEN several SNOW PLOWS are staggered across a freeway, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass between them.

rules.title: Do-not-pass sign
rules.when: the DRIVER is on a road with the do-not-pass sign
rules.action: pass on that road
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is on a road with the do-not-pass sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass on that road.

rules.title: Do not pass a pilot or pace vehicle with a flashing sign
rules.when: the DRIVER is approaching a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bearing the do-not-pass sign AND the sign is flashing
rules.action: pass the pilot vehicle or pace vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is approaching a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bearing the do-not-pass sign AND the sign is flashing, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the pilot vehicle or pace vehicle.

rules.title: Solid line at the left: do not pass
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass.
rules.note: The text says the line 'means it is unsafe to pass' and the diagram note says 'should not pass'.

rules.title: Broken line at the left: passing allowed
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the pass safely
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the pass safely, the DRIVER MAY pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Low beams when approaching from behind at night
rules.when: the DRIVER is about to pass a vehicle at night AND is approaching it from behind
rules.action: switch the headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is about to pass a vehicle at night AND is approaching it from behind, the DRIVER MUST switch the headlights to low beams.

rules.title: Signal, check and high beams alongside at night
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a vehicle at night
rules.action: signal, check the mirrors and blind spot, and pull out to pass, and switch on the high beams as the vehicle moves alongside the vehicle being passed
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a vehicle at night, the DRIVER MUST signal, check the mirrors and blind spot, and pull out to pass, and switch on the high beams as the vehicle moves alongside the vehicle being passed.

rules.title: Return to the right lane at night when the front is visible
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a vehicle at night AND can see all of the front of the vehicle being passed in the rear view mirror
rules.action: pull back into the right lane and signal
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a vehicle at night AND can see all of the front of the vehicle being passed in the rear view mirror, the DRIVER MUST pull back into the right lane and signal.

rules.title: Right shoulder only to pass a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: the shoulder is paved
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder to pass a vehicle turning left
rules.statement: WHEN the shoulder is paved, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive on the right shoulder to pass a vehicle turning left.

rules.title: No passing on the left shoulder
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a vehicle
rules.action: pass on the left shoulder, paved or not
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder, paved or not.

rules.title: Passing on the right allowed in certain cases
rules.when: the DRIVER is on a multi-lane road OR a one-way road OR the DRIVER is overtaking a streetcar OR a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is on a multi-lane road OR a one-way road OR the DRIVER is overtaking a streetcar OR a left-turning vehicle, the DRIVER MAY pass on the right.

rules.title: Wait for the slower vehicle to move right before passing on the right
rules.when: the DRIVER is in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: wait for the slower vehicle to move to the right
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front, the DRIVER MUST wait for the slower vehicle to move to the right.

rules.title: Do not suddenly change lanes to pass on the right
rules.when: the DRIVER is in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: suddenly change lanes and pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front, the DRIVER MUST NOT suddenly change lanes and pass on the right.

rules.title: Pass streetcars on the right unless one-way
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a streetcar
rules.action: pass the streetcar on the right
rules.unless: the DRIVER is on a one-way road
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a streetcar, the DRIVER MUST pass the streetcar on the right, UNLESS the DRIVER is on a one-way road.

rules.title: Stay two metres behind the rear doors at a streetcar stop
rules.when: the DRIVER is at a streetcar stop where passengers are getting off or on
rules.action: stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors
rules.unless: an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers at the stop
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is at a streetcar stop where passengers are getting off or on, the DRIVER MUST stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors, UNLESS an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers at the stop.

rules.title: Pass set-aside streetcar passenger areas at a reasonable speed
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a set-aside streetcar passenger area
rules.action: pass the area at a reasonable speed and be prepared for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a set-aside streetcar passenger area, the DRIVER MUST pass the area at a reasonable speed and be prepared for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves.

rules.title: Cyclists: one metre
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: maintain a minimum distance of 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER of a motor vehicle is passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST maintain a minimum distance of 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when 1 metre is impractical

rules.note: The same block advises changing lanes to pass whenever possible (separate rule).

rules.title: Change lanes to pass cyclists whenever possible
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: change lanes to pass, whenever possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER SHOULD change lanes to pass, whenever possible.

rules.title: Do not sound the horn unnecessarily when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: the DRIVER is overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn unnecessarily
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST NOT sound the horn unnecessarily.

rules.title: Tap the horn lightly from a distance when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: the DRIVER must use the horn while overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER must use the horn while overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST.

rules.title: Do not cut in front closely when passing a large vehicle
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: cut in front of the LARGE VEHICLE closely
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST NOT cut in front of the LARGE VEHICLE closely.

rules.title: Allow more room when passing a large vehicle
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: allow more room
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST allow more room.

rules.title: Do not pass farm machinery until safe
rules.when: the DRIVER is behind FARM MACHINERY displaying the SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN
rules.action: pass the FARM MACHINERY
rules.unless: it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is behind FARM MACHINERY displaying the SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the FARM MACHINERY, UNLESS it is safe to do so.

rules.title: Pass a horse-drawn vehicle only when safe
rules.when: the DRIVER is behind a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE
rules.action: pass the HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE
rules.unless: it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is behind a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE, UNLESS it is safe to do so.

rules.title: Give as much distance as possible when passing a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE
rules.action: give as much distance between the vehicle and the HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE as possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE, the DRIVER SHOULD give as much distance between the vehicle and the HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE as possible.

rules.title: Wait for a smaller vehicle to move right before passing it at a left turn
rules.when: the DRIVER is making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: stay behind and wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before passing it
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST stay behind and wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before passing it.

rules.title: Watch for doors when passing parked vehicles
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing parked vehicles, the DRIVER MUST watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload.

rules.title: Pass motorcycles and bicycles by changing lanes
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: pass by changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST pass by changing lanes.

rules.title: Do not pass a motorcycle or bicycle in the same lane when it pulls to the side
rules.when: a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped pulls to the side of its lane
rules.action: pass it in the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped pulls to the side of its lane, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass it in the same lane.

rules.title: Slow down and pass with caution when passing workers or disabled vehicles on the road
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing workers or disabled vehicles on the road
rules.action: slow down and pass with caution
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing workers or disabled vehicles on the road, the DRIVER MUST slow down and pass with caution.
rules.note: This is about passing hazards on the road (workers, roadside assistance and disabled vehicles), not overtaking in traffic.

rules.title: Move over a lane when passing workers or disabled vehicles if safe
rules.when: the DRIVER is passing workers or disabled vehicles on the road AND it is safe to do so
rules.action: move over a lane to increase the space between the vehicle and the hazard
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is passing workers or disabled vehicles on the road AND it is safe to do so, the DRIVER MUST move over a lane to increase the space between the vehicle and the hazard.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another driver is trying to pass the DRIVER
rules.action: speed up
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up.
rules.note: The handbook calls this unlawful and dangerous.

rules.title: Move right and let faster traffic pass
rules.when: faster traffic wants to pass the DRIVER
rules.action: move to the right and let the faster traffic pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and let the faster traffic pass in safety.

rules.title: Watch oncoming traffic and move right when being passed on an undivided road
rules.when: the DRIVER is being passed on an undivided road AND the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is being passed on an undivided road AND the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER MUST pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane.

rules.title: Be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver get in front
rules.when: the DRIVER is being passed
rules.action: be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver get in front more quickly
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is being passed, the DRIVER MUST be prepared to slow down to let the passing driver get in front more quickly.

rules.title: Move right when a truck wants to pass in the truck passing lane
rules.when: the DRIVER is in the TRUCK PASSING LANE AND a truck wants to pass
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in the TRUCK PASSING LANE AND a truck wants to pass, the DRIVER MUST move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible.

rules.title: Trucks not allowed in the far left lane on high-speed roads
rules.when: a truck is on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction
rules.action: drive in the far left-hand lane
rules.statement: WHEN a truck is on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction, the truck MUST NOT drive in the far left-hand lane.
rules.note: Stated for high-speed roads in 10.26 and for freeways in 12.24, which also says trucks must use the lane to the right for passing.

rules.title: Slower traffic must keep right on multi-lane roads
rules.when: the DRIVER is driving slower traffic on a multi-lane road
rules.action: keep to the right
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is driving slower traffic on a multi-lane road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right.

rules.title: Towing: signal and pull over when holding up traffic
rules.when: the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND is holding up a line of traffic
rules.action: signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND is holding up a line of traffic, the DRIVER MUST signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass.

rules.title: Towing: do not brake when the trailer is whipped by a passing truck or bus
rules.when: a large bus or truck passes the DRIVER towing a trailer AND the trailer is whipped to the side
rules.action: brake
rules.statement: WHEN a large bus or truck passes the DRIVER towing a trailer AND the trailer is whipped to the side, the DRIVER MUST NOT brake.

rules.title: Towing: steer the trailer back into position when whipped by a passing truck or bus
rules.when: a large bus or truck passes the DRIVER towing a trailer AND the trailer is whipped to the side
rules.action: carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position
rules.statement: WHEN a large bus or truck passes the DRIVER towing a trailer AND the trailer is whipped to the side, the DRIVER MUST carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position.

rules.title: Slower vehicles may move into the right-hand lane on a passing or climbing lane
rules.when: the DRIVER is a slower vehicle on a road with a passing or climbing lane
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane to let faster vehicles pass in the left lane
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is a slower vehicle on a road with a passing or climbing lane, the DRIVER MAY move into the right-hand lane to let faster vehicles pass in the left lane.

rules.title: Merge safely when the passing or climbing lane is ending
rules.when: the DRIVER is in the right-hand lane AND the passing or climbing lane is ending
rules.action: merge safely with traffic in the left-hand lane
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in the right-hand lane AND the passing or climbing lane is ending, the DRIVER SHOULD merge safely with traffic in the left-hand lane.

rules.title: Towing: ensure enough time and room before passing
rules.when: the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND is about to pass
rules.action: make sure there is enough time and room to complete the pass
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND is about to pass, the DRIVER MUST make sure there is enough time and room to complete the pass.

rules.title: Towing: allow more room before returning to the lane
rules.when: the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND has passed
rules.action: allow more room before moving back to the lane
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND has passed, the DRIVER MUST allow more room before moving back to the lane.

rules.title: Towing: do not cut back into the lane too soon
rules.when: the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND has passed
rules.action: cut back into the lane too soon
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is towing a trailer AND has passed, the DRIVER MUST NOT cut back into the lane too soon.
